description: Find all friends-of-friends between 1 and 3 hops away from Ada Lovelace in the social network.

expected_queries.cypher:
MATCH (p1:Person {firstName: $p0})-[:KNOWS*1..3]->(friend:Person)
RETURN DISTINCT p1.firstName AS start_person, friend.firstName AS friend_name, friend.email AS friend_email
ORDER BY friend.firstName ASC
expected_queries.sql_pgq:
SELECT DISTINCT
  gt.start_person,
  gt.friend_name,
  gt.friend_email
FROM GRAPH_TABLE (
  social_graph
  MATCH (p1:Person WHERE p1.first_name = :p0) -[:KNOWS]->{1,3} (friend:Person)
  COLUMNS (
    p1.first_name AS start_person,
    friend.first_name AS friend_name,
    friend.email AS friend_email
  )
) AS gt
ORDER BY gt.friend_name ASC
expected_queries.iso_gql:
MATCH (p1:Person WHERE p1.firstName = $p0) -[:KNOWS]->{1,3} (friend:Person)
RETURN DISTINCT p1.firstName AS start_person, friend.firstName AS friend_name, friend.email AS friend_email
ORDER BY friend.firstName ASC
